text:
Leah Ortiz: Quick follow-up to the recent OOM postmortem. We need to convert notes into tracked tasks and confirm owners for: repro, jemalloc tuning, compaction prototype, alerts, and CI leak checks.
Noah Kim: I can pick up the repro and allocation traces. Plan: nightly jemalloc stats + perf traces, and a small distributed churn runner. ETA 72h for initial artifacts.
Ibrahim Saleh: Runtime team will prototype two mitigations: 1) background slab defragger, 2) per-shard soft_limit that backpressures writes. I'll land a feature flag PR for the soft_limit first. ETA 10 days.
Leah Ortiz: Action list (summary):
  - Noah: reproducible harness and heap profiles (ETA 3d)
  - Ibrahim: soft_limit flag + basic backpressure (ETA 10d)
  - Tom B. (cc via thread): observability panels + 85% alert (ETA 5d)
  - ops-bot: orchestrate canary at 5% after runtime PR merge
  - pager-bot: emergency page if host-level fragmentation increases >15% in 15m
Noah Kim: Repro notes: use churn_runner with varying object sizes and TTLs. Example run:```
./tools/churn_runner --shards=40 --obj-sizes=256,4096 --ttl=30 --duration=60
curl http://localhost:9100/debug/je_stats > /tmp/je.json
```
Ibrahim Saleh: Compaction approach details: incremental page migration (low CPU) vs full slab rewrite (higher CPU, lower fragmentation). We'll start with incremental migration behind feature flag. Also exploring mallctl arena purge on idle windows.
Leah Ortiz: Rollout plan: dev -> canary (5% for 2h) -> ramp to 25% if fragmentation delta < 2% and P95 latency unchanged. Abort criteria: error rate + write rejections > 0.5% or median latency regresses > 10ms.
Noah Kim: Found a suspicious early-return in key-snapshot path that can leak memory on errors. Adding a unit test to exercise error paths and a sanitizer run on CI.
Ibrahim Saleh: For backpressure: writes return 429 when shard resident > soft_limit, with structured log containing shard_id, resident_bytes, frag_ratio. That should make it easy to correlate with alerts.
Tom B.: (pasted into thread) I'll create a Grafana dashboard with per-shard: resident_bytes, allocated_bytes, frag_ratio=(allocated >0 ? resident/allocated : 0), and compaction_runs. Alert at 85% host resident or frag_ratio > 1.25 for 10m. Will point notifications to #eng-runtime and trigger pager-bot when host-level growth > 12% in 10m.
Leah Ortiz: Schedule: weekly sync for the next 5 weeks, Wednesdays 9:30am. Ibrahim to own invites. We'll post progress as brief thread replies.
ops-bot: Canary scheduled to run after PR merge. Will notify thread on start.
pager-bot: Paging policy applied: will page on configured thresholds.
Noah Kim: PR opened for repro harness: perf/repro/1833055555-churn. Initial flamegraphs uploaded to postmortem doc.
Ibrahim Saleh: Draft PR for soft_limit behind flag opened; request review from Leah and Noah.
Leah Ortiz: Good. Please update the postmortem checklist with your PR links and set item status to "in-progress" when you start. I'll escalate any blockers in the weekly sync. Thanks. :white_check_mark:
